NeoV8 for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel, macOS 11 or later)
=============================================================

Nothing else to install.

App:     drag NeoV8.app into Applications.
Plugins: copy NeoV8.clap to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/
         and NeoV8.vst3 to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/ (create the folders if needed), then rescan in your DAW.

These builds are not notarised by Apple. The first time, right-click NeoV8.app and choose Open (or allow it in
System Settings > Privacy & Security). For the plugins, if your DAW refuses them, run in Terminal:
    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP/NeoV8.clap ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/VST3/NeoV8.vst3

No sound bank is included: the instrument starts with an init bank. Load your own with LOAD BANK (SysEx .syx,
cassette recording .wav, or 8 KB battery image .bin). Your programs are kept in
~/Library/Application Support/NeoV8/battery.bin (the app) or in the DAW project (the plugin).

NeoV8 is free software (GPL-3.0-or-later): https://github.com/r0main-f/neov8
